title: WHIP output
description: Where to POST the programme, and what to do when the endpoint is not there.

endpoint.title: WHIP endpoint
endpoint.description: The URL the service gave you. It looks like https://example.com/whip/<stream> and it is the only thing most services need.

token.title: Bearer token
token.description: Sent as an Authorization: Bearer header. Leave empty for an endpoint that wants no authentication.

stun_server.title: STUN server
stun_server.description: How the sender learns its own public address. stun://host:port. Leave empty to use the element's default, which is usually enough on an ordinary network.

turn_server.title: TURN server
turn_server.description: A relay for when the two ends cannot reach each other directly, which is what a strict corporate firewall causes. turn://user:password@host:port, or turns:// for TLS.

timeout_secs.title: Endpoint timeout
timeout_secs.description: How long to wait for the endpoint to answer the POST. 0 waits forever.

reconnect_first_ms.title: First reconnect wait
reconnect_first_ms.description: How long to wait before dialling again the first time the endpoint drops. It doubles from here.

reconnect_max_ms.title: Longest reconnect wait
reconnect_max_ms.description: Where the doubling stops. Keep it short: an output that is down holds the core's outage buffer open, and that buffer is finite.
